prompt:
In `shelf/isbn.py` add two conversion functions.

`isbn10_to_isbn13(raw)`: accept an ISBN-10 in any form `normalize_isbn` accepts (hyphens, spaces, lower-case `x`); raise `ValueError` unless it is a valid ISBN-10 (a 13-digit ISBN is also an error); return the 13-digit string made of `978`, the first nine digits of the ISBN-10, and a freshly computed ISBN-13 check digit.

`isbn13_to_isbn10(raw)`: the inverse for valid ISBN-13s that start with `978`: return the 10-character form (the nine digits after `978` plus a computed ISBN-10 check digit, `X` for 10). Raise `ValueError` for anything that is not a valid ISBN-13 or that starts with `979`.

Keep the existing tests passing (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`).
